entries.appliesTo: New Jersey Economic Development Authority tax-credit allocations under the Next New Jersey Program Act

params.scope: Next New Jersey Program credit-cap cut $500M to $250M

sources.scope: § 1, amending b.(1)(k) of section 98 of P.L.2020, c.156 (C.34:1B-362) — 'an amount not to exceed [$500,000,000] $250,000,000 shall be made available for projects awarded a tax credit pursuant to the "Next New Jersey Program Act," P.L.2024, c.49 (C.34:1B-394 et al.)'

flags: no-compliance-duty: bill imposes no obligation on any private party or ongoing duty on an agency beyond the reallocated incentive cap; cost impact is forgone tax credits, not compliance work

ai-nexus-indirect: the enacted text never uses 'artificial intelligence' and uses 'data center' only in the act's designation ('designated as the "End Data Center Tax Credits Act"'); the AI/data-center connection runs through the cross-referenced Next New Jersey Program Act, P.L.2024, c.49, which this text does not describe

reprint-deletions: the June 24, 2026 Senate Budget and Appropriations Committee amendments (First Reprint) struck the introduced bill's entire operative regime — energy-storage tax credits (former §§ 2-5), the $100 residential-ratepayer gross-income-tax credit for income ≤ $55,000 (former § 6), and rulemaking authority (former § 7); the subparagraph (n) allocation and § 98(a) program-list reference to this act were likewise bracket-deleted; only the § 1 cap reduction and the immediate effective-date clause remain operative

category-fit: no CODING.md category cleanly fits a tax-credit reallocation; coded public-sector/data-centers as closest fit because the only entity whose behavior the text constrains is the state authority administering the cap
legiscan.js relations show only 'same as' companion A 5165 — no 'replaced by' relation, so not coded as duplicate
